entries.headline: War Watch relays report of two tankers attacked in Hormuz
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report attributed to UKMTO alleging that Iranian forces attacked two tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. It said one tanker caught fire and no crew were injured, crediting @reagan0965. The post did not independently establish responsibility for the reported attacks.

entries.headline: Command jet, six transports and four coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force nuclear command-and-control jet airborne over the continental United States alongside six heavy transport aircraft. It reported four coded radio broadcasts that day, with the latest at 21:14 Zulu, without identifying their content or linking them to the flights.

entries.headline: RC-135S Cobra Ball sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a sighting of a Boeing RC-135S Cobra Ball, registration 61-2663 and hex code AE01D6, with no callsign supplied. It credited reagan0965 but did not specify the aircraft's location, route or mission.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report of tanker struck near Oman
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a report attributed to UKMTO that an oil tanker was struck by a projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz, approximately four nautical miles east of Oman, crediting @reagan0965. The visible post did not give a complete incident date or identify who fired the projectile.

entries.headline: CNV4794 C-40A Clipper sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a sighting of Boeing C-40A Clipper CNV4794, identified with the US Navy Air Logistics Office, registration 165831 and hex code AE04D9. It credited reagan0965 without specifying the aircraft's location, route or mission.

entries.headline: Transport flights and three coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft airborne over the United States, with three coded radio broadcasts heard that day. The post did not identify the messages' content or connect them to a specific operation.

entries.headline: Five transports, command jet and two coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five US Air Force cargo transport aircraft airborne over the United States alongside a nuclear command-and-control jet. It also reported two coded Air Force radio broadcasts, without identifying their content or establishing a connection with the flights.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report of Kyiv embassy contingency plans
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared a Guardian report that Western nations were preparing contingency plans to relocate their embassies from Kyiv if the security situation worsened, crediting @reagan0965. The post described conditional planning rather than a confirmed relocation.

entries.headline: Two coded broadcasts and increased regional air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported two coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard so far that day and described transport and surveillance aircraft activity over the United States, Gulf region and Baltic as increased. It did not identify the messages' content, aircraft missions or a specific operation.

entries.headline: VENUS70 C-32A sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a sighting of Boeing C-32A VENUS70, registration 98-0001 and hex code ADFEB7, crediting reagan0965. The visible post did not specify its location, route or mission.

entries.headline: War Watch shares report of sanctions on alleged Hamas finance network
entries.summary: War Watch Intel shared an Insider Paper report that the United States sanctioned an alleged Hamas finance network, including two France-based charities, crediting @reagan0965. The visible post did not name the organizations or provide details of the allegations.

entries.headline: Five heavy transports and earlier coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside a surveillance aircraft. It also reported one coded radio broadcast heard earlier that day, without identifying its content or linking it to the flights.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Nakijin
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Nakijin, Japan. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report of Super Hornet submarine kill marking
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared an Aviationist report describing a VFA-41 F/A-18F Super Hornet returning from Operation Epic Fury with a submarine kill marking. Its commentary attributed the marking to an Iranian submarine engagement from USS Abraham Lincoln; the post relayed the report rather than providing independent confirmation.

entries.headline: New P-8 ground alert at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued another ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Oak Harbor, Washington. This separately dated post did not supply a callsign or confirm the reason for the aircraft's ground status or a specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Oak Harbor
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US-registered Boeing P-8 Poseidon at Oak Harbor, Washington. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a specific mission or reason for the aircraft's ground status.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on Otto Aerospace and MQ-9 successor search
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a War Zone article describing Otto Aerospace as a contender in the search for an MQ-9 Reaper successor and highlighting its Celera 500L design. The post relayed the article rather than announcing a confirmed replacement selection.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report of Taiwan's first F-16 Block 70 arrivals
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a War Zone report that Taiwan's first two F-16 Block 70 fighters had arrived. The visible post did not supply delivery dates or further details, and its account was presented through the linked news report.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report of Taiwan receiving new F-16 pair
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Breaking Defense report that Taiwan had received its first pair of new F-16 fighter jets after years of delay. The post relayed the report without providing an independent confirmation or additional delivery details.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Anchorage
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Anchorage, Alaska. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's mission or reason for being on the ground.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert near Reykjanesbaer
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 near Reykjanesbaer, Iceland. The post reported ground status without supplying a callsign or confirming the aircraft's mission.

entries.headline: SCWTP32 E-2 departure alert near Norfolk
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for SCWTP32, a US-registered military E-2, near Norfolk, Virginia. The post reported a departure without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Plainfield
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Plainfield, Indiana. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the reason for its ground status or a specific mission.

entries.headline: APACHE E3CF departure alert at Penaflor
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for APACHE, an aircraft labeled E3CF, at Penaflor, Chile. The post described a UK-registered military E-3C warning and control aircraft but did not confirm the flight's destination or mission.
